comment: The built-in demo feeds: each directory here is a feed, and <id>.report.json is what gtfs-validator reported for it. The Tours view tries tours on them. See README.md for how they are built and refreshed.

demos.title: Main network
demos.description: One small network with as many problems as can coexist: a stop off its shape, a 12 km hop in a minute, broken shapes and pathways, flexible trips, Fares v2, and the row-level parse errors.

demos.title: Starts in the future
demos.description: Service and feed dates after the validation date, a feed ending within 30 days, and translations problems.

demos.title: No calendar
demos.description: No calendar, calendar dates or agency files; two feed_info rows; a locations.geojson that is not JSON.

demos.title: Parse errors
demos.description: One unreadable value per file, broken headers, an empty file, an over-long value and a malformed GeoJSON feature.

demos.title: Validator crash
demos.description: A calendar that ends before it starts, which stops two validators with an exception, and a GeoJSON root that is a Feature.

demos.title: Files in a subfolder
demos.description: A valid feed whose files sit inside a gtfs/ folder.
